title: Keep future re-excitation after a finite near-swap
statement: The reviewed occupied-factor allowance is W+2sqrt(eta E W)+(1+sqrt(2))eta E sqrt(W)+eta E W/2. At eta=0 it still includes W from future re-excitation. Passive vacuum loss contracts N and factorial N(N-1) by the joint total-number argument,not by incorrectly squaring an operator inequality.

requires: Exact retained mixed state,source references,active fields and actual records carried across the cut
All source–bath couplings disabled during both finite control windows;wrong selectors are included
Actual total second-number moment contract and remaining exposure,including both continua and every intermediate full-bath comparison
Fresh vacuum dumps with no return path
provides: A source-bound finite-loss retirement debit preserving the other marginal even under correlations
assumptions: Residual passive phase remains in the channel description
E is the pre-dump retired mean and W the remaining squared exposure
No count output or subsequent dump return
costs: Finite control areas,timing,mode calibration,preparation and total remaining exposure are charged separately
Chosen1e-6 allowance is a model comparison budget,not device noise,total workload error or a fault threshold
Area pi/2+error with |error|<=1e-3,intensity transmissivity<=1e-6;source-local model time and pulse units
contract.units: Dimensionless probabilities/Bell loss/half-diamond error as explicitly stated; source calls, resets, memory and control gates are separate costs.
contract.obstruction: Perfect emptying at a cut does not remove future source coupling.

body: The dump spends two fresh vacuum modes,never returned;parity spends two hidden bits and may retain occupation. Negative retained transmission includes a residual passive phase. The nonempty preparation witness is pre-absorption,not a post-dump state. Bounds do not establish a universal hardware winner,energy/work conservation or a measured actuator. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
